page.notes: Printed page with the running head "De Authoritate, & Dignitate" and "Cap. 2." Right margin on the scan is clear. The left-margin reference note is printed in three short lines and is transcribed as one note. The word "grina" at the end of the last line is printed right-aligned and continues "peregrina"; its paragraph ends on that word. Some letterforms in the scan are unclear (the "tasse" and "claudere" lines, and the hyphen after "pere-"), so the printed hyphen placement there is uncertain. The left margin note has no printed letter of its own before "Epsen"; the mark "u" is taken from the text.
